title: French Student Protests Broaden as Workers and Unions Join Movement
detail: French student protests are broadening significantly as workers and unions join the movement, expanding it well beyond student demographics. People of all ages are participating, transforming what began as a lycée blockade movement into a wider social mobilisation involving organised labour. The expansion signals growing public discontent beyond education and national service policies.

media.caption: Workers and unions join French student protests, broadening the movement across age groups

title: France Suspends Stun Grenades After Student Protester Loses Hand
detail: France has suspended the use of stun grenades after a student protester lost their hand picking one up during ongoing school protests. The policy reversal marks a significant shift in crowd control approach amid continuing demonstrations across France.

media.caption: France suspends stun grenades after student protester loses hand
